findings.body: The branch adds `codex.attach()` and the driver's attachment request path, but no test invokes either path. The new stub accepts `thread/attachment/add`, yet every command exercised by the tests is work or read; deleting the attachment implementation would leave these tests green. Add coverage of this branch's attachment interface through the real driver and SDK, checking the recorded thread, identity and payload, no request without a recorded conversation, and non-fatal request failure. This covers START's interface without requiring ATTACH's later `forge close` integration.
findings.title: Not done: attachment request tests
